records.subject: Education, Language Spoken and Literacy
records.groupTitle: Proportion Of Students Achieving At Least A Minimum Proficiency In Reading And Mathematics By Level And Sex
records.title: Proportion Of Students Achieving At Least A Minimum Proficiency In Reading And Mathematics By Level And Sex, Annual
records.dataSource: PROGRESS IN INTERNATIONAL READING LITERACY STUDY (PIRLS), PROGRAMME FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENT ASSESSMENT (PISA) AND TRENDS IN INTERNATIONAL MATHEMATICS AND SCIENCE STUDY (TIMSS)
records.footnote: Data are used for SDG 4.1.1 ‘Proportion of children and young people (a) in grades 2/3; (b) at the end of primary; and (c) at the end of lower secondary achieving at least a minimum proficiency level in (i) reading and (ii) mathematics, by sex’. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 4.1.1.

row.rowText: Proportion Of Students In Primary Education Achieving At Least A Minimum Proficiency Level In Reading
row.footnote: Data for the primary grade levels were taken from (a) Progress in International Reading Literacy Study (PIRLS) and (b) Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study (TIMSS), both of which target Grade 4 or Primary 4 students.

row.rowText: Proportion Of Students In Secondary Education Achieving At Least A Minimum Proficiency Level In Reading
row.footnote: Data for the secondary levels were taken from TIMSS targeting Grade 8 or Secondary 2 students and the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) targeting 15-year-olds.
